hidden.description: Hidden achievements show no description until unlocked.

icon.description: Store icon (the coloured one when unlocked, the grey one when locked).

rarityPercent.description: Share of players who unlocked it, 0–100; null if unknown.

AppErrorPayload.description: Error shape of every rejected Tauri command.

BackupInfo.description: One save backup of a game.

id.description: Folder name (the time), used to restore it.

BackupSettings.description: Save backups of every game (save locations from the Ludusavi manifest).

directory.description: Where backups go; empty = Cove's app data folder.

CatalogCredentials.description: Credentials entered in Settings; stored in the OS keyring, never returned to the UI.

libraryGameId.description: Library game linked to this catalogue entry, if any.

offline.description: True when the provider was unreachable and cached data is shown.

reasons.description: Recommendation reasons by game id (sort "recommended" with the recommender running; else empty).

total.description: Total number of matches, null if the provider does not report it.

useCoveService.description: Use the Cove catalogue service (no own API keys needed).

CatalogSource.description: Where catalogue data comes from, in fallback order.

configured.description: Own credentials stored in the keyring.

online.description: False after the last request failed for network reasons.

sources.description: Sources in the order they are tried; empty = catalogue not available.

Collection.description: One of the user's own collections ("Mit Freunden", "Angefangen" ...). A game can be in several.

gameIds.description: The library games in it, oldest member first.

ConnectableStore.description: Stores that support account connections (everything except manual).

error.description: Null on success and when the user cancelled.

ConnectorLoginMode.description: How the login page is shown: system browser (loopback redirect) or an own window.

ConnectorLoginStart.description: Answer of `connector_login_start`; the result arrives as `connector-login-finished`.

fallbackUrl.description: Alternative login (Epic): open this page in any browser and paste the shown code into Cove (`connector_login_complete`).

CoveAchievement.description: Cove's own achievements, evaluated locally (definitions: JSON, plugins can add more).

available.description: This build knows a proxy URL.

enabled.description: The user has not switched it off.

DirectDownloadInput.description: A direct link (DRM-free game, mod, patch).

title.description: Library title; null = derived from the file name.

DlcOption.description: One DLC in the install dialog.

id.description: GOG product id or Epic app name.

selected.description: Ticked: installed with the game (remembers the last choice for this game).

checksumVerified.description: True once the SHA-256 matched the expected value.

extra.description: itch.io extra (soundtrack …) of the game: its file name; null for the game itself.

installPath.description: Game folder after a successful install.

queuePosition.description: Position in the queue (0-based) for active/queued items, null otherwise.

DownloadItem.description: Download joined with its game metadata.

DownloadOrigin.description: Where a download comes from. Store games are never downloaded by Cove itself.

DownloadProgress.description: Event `download-progress`, at most about 4 per second and download.

bandwidthLimitBytesPerSecond.description: Bandwidth limit in bytes/second, null = unlimited.

EmulatorInfo.description: An emulator for a system and whether it is installed.

EmulatorSettings.description: Folders with ROMs and the emulator that plays them.

FolderInfo.description: A folder the user may install into (install dialog).

freeBytes.description: Free space on its drive, null if unknown.

needsAdmin.description: Windows: below "Program Files", which needs admin rights.

writable.description: Cove may create files there (or create the folder).

Game.description: Catalogue metadata for a game (independent of whether the user owns it).

description.description: Full description, plain text with `\n\n` between paragraphs.

features.description: Extra descriptors for the recommender; null when the source does not provide them.

releaseDate.description: Null when unknown (e.g. unreleased or manually added games).

header.description: Wide header / hero image, 16:9 or wider.

GameBackups.description: Save backups of a game, for its page.

known.description: The manifest knows where this game keeps its saves.

GameId.description: Stable game identifier (store-independent, assigned by the core).

GameMoveProgress.description: Event `game-move-progress` while a game folder is moved.

GamePrice.description: A game's prices in the user's country.

sessionSeconds.description: Length of the finished session in seconds; null while running.

GameTools.description: Which Linux game tools are installed.

GameTweaks.description: Per-game options on Linux for games Cove starts itself.

dxvk.description: Proton: Direct3D 9 to 11 through DXVK (off = WineD3D).

fsr.description: AMD FSR 1 upscaling: gamescope's filter, else GE-Proton's `WINE_FULLSCREEN_FSR`.

gamescopeWidth.description: gamescope: the resolution the game renders at; null = the game's own.

vkd3d.description: Proton: Direct3D 12 through VKD3D-Proton (off = no D3D12).

GameUpdateInfo.description: Update state of a store game Cove installed (GOG, Epic).

ImageRef.description: Reference to an image. `url` is null when no artwork is available yet.

InstallPreview.description: Sizes shown in the install dialog before a download starts.

dlcs.description: Owned DLCs that can be installed with the game (GOG, Epic); sizes above are the game alone.

installBytes.description: Size after the install; null when it is only known after unpacking.

launcherOnly.description: Why Cove can't install it and the store's launcher must (anti-cheat, third-party launcher).

InstallTarget.description: Where the install dialog puts a game.

excludedDlcs.description: DLCs left out (ids from `InstallPreview.dlcs`); kept for later updates.

folder.description: Games folder; Cove creates a subfolder named after the game.

ItchGame.description: An itch.io game the user owns (or a free one).

downloadKeyId.description: Purchase key; null for free games.

extra.description: Not the game itself (soundtrack, artbook …): offered as an extra.

arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments, as typed by the user.

compatibilityTool.description: Linux only: how Windows binaries are run.

protonVersion.description: With Proton: the build to use. `"latest"` = always the newest GE-Proton, a GE-Proton release name (`"GE-Proton10-25"`), or `"steam:<folder>"` for a build Steam installed. null = the default (`library.defaultProton`).

tweaks.description: Linux: MangoHud, GameMode, gamescope, FSR, DXVK/VKD3D (games Cove starts itself).

tracked.description: False when Cove cannot observe the game (started via a store client without known install folder).

LaunchVia.description: How a game is started: by Cove itself or through a store client.

LibraryEntry.description: A game in the user's library.

catalogId.description: Linked catalogue entry (e.g. `igdb-1942`), null if not matched.

executablePath.description: Absolute path of the file Cove starts (.exe, binary, AppImage, .desktop, script).

installPath.description: Absolute path of the install directory, null if not installed.

installSizeBytes.description: Size on disk in bytes, null if not installed.

installedByCove.description: Installed by Cove's download manager: Cove may move and uninstall it.

launchVia.description: How "Spielen" starts the game; null when it can't be started yet.

storeGameId.description: Store-specific id (e.g. Steam app id) used for URL-scheme launches; null for manual games.

LibraryItem.description: Library entry joined with its game metadata — what list views render.

defaultProton.description: Linux: Proton build for games without a choice of their own (`"latest"` by default).

epicCloudSaves.description: Sync Epic cloud saves before and after playing (games Cove installed).

gameFolders.description: Folders games are installed into (e.g. one per drive). The default is `downloads.directory`.

gogCloudSaves.description: Sync GOG cloud saves before and after playing (games Cove installed).

steamSilentStart.description: Start Steam with `-silent` (tray only) before a Steam game starts.

useUmu.description: Linux: start Proton through umu-launcher (Steam Linux Runtime, per-game fixes).

LibraryUpdate.description: Partial update of a library entry; omitted fields stay unchanged.

LocalStoreGame.description: A game installed on this computer, found without login.

ManualGameInput.description: Input for adding a game manually.

sizeBytes.description: Known size on disk (from a folder scan), null if unknown.

MatchStatus.description: Catalogue matching state of a library game: none = not matched (yet) · pending = suggestions wait for the user · matched = metadata applied · rejected = user declined all suggestions.

PlayStats.description: Statistics page: playtime over a year or all time (`stats_overview`).

daysPlayed.description: Days with at least one session.

gamesPlayed.description: Games with playtime in the range.

genres.description: Minutes per genre, most first (a game with two genres counts for both).

longestStreakDays.description: Most days in a row with a session.

months.description: Twelve months, oldest first: the year's months, or the last 12 for all time.

totalMinutes.description: Playtime in the range. All time includes playtime imported from the stores; a year only counts sessions Cove tracked.

weekdays.description: Tracked minutes per weekday, Monday first (7 entries).

year.description: The year shown; null = all time.

years.description: Years with tracked sessions, newest first.

days.description: One entry per day, oldest first (no gaps).

executablePath.description: Null adds the game without install (Cove looks up catalogue data).

entryUrl.description: Module URL for the worker; only for active plugins.

removable.description: Installed into Cove's plugin folder (development plugins cannot be removed here).

PluginManifestPreview.description: `plugin.json` of a folder the user wants to install (shown in the permission dialog).

alreadyInstalled.description: An older version is installed already (it will be replaced).

PluginPermission.description: What a plugin may do. The user confirms them when installing.

PluginStatus.description:
- `active`: approved and enabled, runs in its own worker
- `disabled`: approved, switched off by the user
- `needsApproval`: new, or an update asks for more permissions
- `invalid`: `plugin.json` is broken (see `error`)

PrefixAction.description: open = show the folder · reset = delete it (the next start creates a fresh one) · winetricks = start winetricks for it.

exists.description: The prefix has been created (the game started at least once).

PriceAlert.description: Fired when a wishlist game reaches its target price or goes on sale.

reason.description: "target" = at or below the target price, "sale" = a new discount.

PriceDeal.description: One shop's current offer (from IsThereAnyDeal; links unchanged).

ProtonKind.description: Where a Proton build comes from: GE-Proton (Cove downloads and updates it) or Steam.

checkedAt.description: When the list of GE-Proton releases was last loaded.

latest.description: The build "latest" stands for right now.

offline.description: The release list could not be loaded; only installed builds are listed.

ProtonProgress.description: Event `proton-progress`: one GE-Proton install, at most about 4 per second.

ProtonRating.description: ProtonDB's community rating of a game.

reports.description: Number of user reports behind the tier.

steamAppId.description: The Steam app the rating belongs to (ProtonDB rates Steam versions).

ProtonTier.description: ProtonDB tier: how well a Windows game runs on Linux through Proton.

ProtonVersion.description: A Proton build a game can use.

games.description: Library games that start with this build (directly, as "latest" or as the default).

removable.description: Cove may delete it: a GE-Proton build no game uses.

ProxyError.description: Body of every non-2xx proxy response.

ProxyMatchResponse.description: `POST /v1/match` — best catalogue candidates for a title, best first.

ProxyPricesRequest.description: `POST /v1/prices`: current prices of games, looked up by title on IsThereAnyDeal.

games.description: At most 50; `key` comes back as the key of the answer.

items.description: Per requested key; null = not found on IsThereAnyDeal.

private.description: True when Steam hides the games (profile or "game details" private).

public.description: False when the profile is private (library and achievements are hidden).

ProxyTimeToBeatResponse.description: Times per IGDB game id; ids without reports are left out.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason, e.g. "Weil du Tidewater gespielt hast".

RecommenderGame.description: A catalogue game as the recommender sees it (content features + prior).

RecommenderLibraryGame.description: A library game as the recommender sees it (interaction signals).

gameId.description: Catalogue id when linked, otherwise the library game id.

arguments.description: `custom`: the arguments, `{rom}` stands for the ROM file.

emulator.description: Emulator id of the system (`retroarch`, `dolphin` …) or `custom`.

program.description: Program to run instead of the one found on the system (needed for `custom`).

RomScanResult.description: Result of scanning the ROM folders.

ScanCandidate.description: A game found while scanning a folder (suggestion — the user confirms).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the game folder in bytes.

ServiceStatus.description: Health of a component. Sidecars start on first use, so `idle` is normal.

connected.description: True while a login is stored (also when it needs to be renewed).

gameCount.description: Number of games imported from this store.

StoreDlc.description: A DLC of a store game as the store sees it (Steam: managed in Steam itself).

unlockOnly.description: GOG/Epic: no files of its own, the game unlocks it through the login.

total.description: All DLCs of the game; the list is cut off for games with hundreds.

helpUrl.description: Where the user can fix it (e.g. Steam privacy settings).

SyncProgress.description: Event `store-sync-progress` while a background sync runs.

SystemInfo.description: A console Cove can play ROMs of.

extensions.description: ROM file extensions (lower case, without the dot).

TimeToBeat.description: How long a game takes, in seconds (IGDB "time to beat", from player reports).

UmuSource.description: Where the umu-launcher Cove uses comes from: the system's package or Cove's own download.

UmuStatus.description: umu-launcher: runs Proton inside the Steam Linux Runtime, like Steam does.

latest.description: Newest release, when the list could be loaded.

source.description: null = not on this machine yet.

version.description: Version of Cove's copy (null for the system's).

UninstallMethod.description: What `game_uninstall` did: Cove deleted the folder, or Steam asks and removes the game.

available.description: `null` when Cove is up to date.

canInstall.description: `false` for `.deb`/`.rpm` installs: the package manager updates those.

WishlistItem.description: A game on the wishlist (not owned).

price.description: Last known prices; null until the first check or when IsThereAnyDeal doesn't know the game.

targetPrice.description: Notify when the best price is at or below this (in the price's currency); null = off.

WishlistSettings.description: Wishlist prices (IsThereAnyDeal through the Cove proxy).

country.description: Two-letter country code for prices and currency, e.g. DE.

priceAlerts.description: Check prices every few hours and notify about alerts.
